port_indexing: P1..P6 = indices 0..5; desired for B_PLUS is (j+1)%6
xy_units: cm (device domain as in production FEM)
field_quantity: Hz (out-of-plane H, complex phasor at nodes → linear interp to grid)
normalization: As returned by production Direct-DtN TE0 drive column; absolute scale is solver-consistent within a movie, not absolute SI calib.
phase_time_convention: Phasor convention for animation: frame(t) = Re[Hz * exp(-1j * omega * t)], omega=2*pi*f. DO NOT animate |Hz| as oscillating.
geometry_reference: Same FULL91 / grade-C mesh and port layout as Stage-2 production (orbits_and_masks / build_system projected).
